children: Hikma Pharmaceuticals' new chief financial officer is a "high-calibre hire", RBC Capital Markets' Harry Sephton says. The London-listed pharmaceutical company named ViiV Healthcare's Rebecca Hall as its next chief financial officer on Thursday. Hall's operational and financial experience at ViiV and GSK should translate well to Hikma, RBC says. The analyst expects an orderly transition at Hikma, with interim CFO Areb Kurdi staying in his role until Hall starts next year. Shares are up 1.2%. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
